blocks.heading: ICONS FOR VISUAL CODE
blocks.body: I was hired to create the icon system for Bolt, translating programming concepts into symbols that could remain distinct and readable inside a dense node-based tool. After Unity acquired Bolt from its original creator, Ludiq, the icons were carried into Unity Visual Scripting and became part of the larger Unity ecosystem. The exact icon count and original production date still need to be recovered before this becomes a full case study.

title: BOLT.UNITY
heading: BOLT
description: An icon design system for Bolt visual scripting that later became part of Unity Visual Scripting and the wider Unity editor ecosystem.
